clue.text: People engaged in a welcome correspondence

indicators.note: to be engaged in something is to be held within it, so one piece sits inside another

parts.note: to greet someone is to welcome them
men is a common crossword word for people

explanation.surface: Folk are taking part in a friendly exchange of letters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Correspondence' looks like an exchange of letters, but here it means things matching up.
explanation.definitionFit: Correspondence in the sense of matching or consistency is a synonym for being in accord.

clue.text: Arterial way of vital importance

parts.note: an arterial road is a main route; here the main route is the body's chief artery, vital for life

explanation.definitionFit: The body's main artery carries blood from the heart, so it is the most vital blood vessel.

clue.text: Shows respect, or perhaps the reverse

indicators.note: perhaps hints the word reverse could come out in a different order

explanation.surface: Someone either honours something or does the opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or' and 'the' are link words; the word 'reverse' looks like an instruction to read backwards, but it is the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: To revere is to honour deeply, so this verb form means shows respect.

clue.text: Concluded that many are in dire need

indicators.note: are in places the letter inside the rearranged word
dire suggests a terrible state, so the word need is rearranged

parts.note: D is 500 in Roman numerals, many

explanation.surface: Many people living in poverty have given up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dire' turns NEED into ENED, and 'are in' puts D inside it. 'that' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Ended is a synonym for concluded, meaning finished.

clue.text: Finish with terribly sore back

parts.note: an end is a finish

indicators.note: terribly suggests disorder, so the word sore is rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone completes a job with an aching back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' at the end looks like part of the painful scene, but it is the definition; 'terribly' turns SORE into ORSE.
explanation.definitionFit: To endorse a candidate or plan is to support it, a synonym for back.

clue.text: Passing test, ran in all excited

indicators.note: excited means stirred up, so all these letters are jumbled together

explanation.surface: A student who passed an exam rushed in thrilled.
explanation.definitionFit: Transient means brief or fleeting, a synonym for passing.

clue.text: Outmoded tables may end up on the fire

definitions.meaning: logarithm tables, books of figures used for calculation before electronic calculators

definitions.text: may end up on the fire
definitions.meaning: cut lengths of wood are burnt on a fire

explanation.definitionFit: Log is short for logarithm, whose printed tables are now obsolete; it is also a cut piece of a tree trunk for burning.

clue.text: Tract of grassland left untidy

parts.note: lea is a poetic word for meadow or grassland

indicators.note: untidy means messed up, so the word left is rearranged

explanation.surface: A strip of meadow has been left in a mess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tract' looks like a stretch of land, but it is a pamphlet; 'untidy' turns LEFT into FLET.
explanation.definitionFit: A tract is a short pamphlet, often religious or political, which is what a leaflet is.

clue.text: A spirited community? Surely not!

parts.note: spirited suggests lively, but read as full of spirits it describes a deserted place where only phantoms live

explanation.definitionFit: An abandoned settlement with no living residents is said to be inhabited only by spirits.

clue.text: Lent on condition

definitions.meaning: lent here means supplied or furnished, past tense
as a conjunction meaning if, on the condition that

explanation.definitionFit: Supplied is a synonym for lent; the same word is also a conjunction meaning only if.

clue.text: River shrew?

definitions.meaning: a shrew is a scolding, aggressive woman, like the warrior women of Greek legend

explanation.definitionFit: The South American river shares its name with the legendary female warriors, so the word also means a fierce, domineering woman.

clue.text: Heartbroken number show ill will

indicators.note: something broken is in pieces, so the letters of the word heart are rearranged

parts.note: D is 500 in Roman numerals, a number

explanation.surface: A grieving person is shown to bear spite.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signal sits inside the single word 'Heartbroken', so the surface hides it; 'show' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense dislike or ill will is what the word names: a strong feeling of loathing.

clue.text: Determined to produce two notes on old instrument

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
so (soh) is the fifth note of the sol-fa scale
the lute is an old plucked string instrument

explanation.surface: Someone sets out to play a couple of notes on an antique instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: Resolute means firmly determined, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Sailor accustomed to being reviled

parts.note: AB is an able seaman, a sailor
used to something means accustomed to it

explanation.surface: A seaman has grown used to being insulted.
explanation.definitionFit: Abused in the sense of verbally insulted is a synonym for reviled.

clue.text: A Schubert composition? Capital!

indicators.note: a composition is something put together, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A piece by the Austrian composer is praised as excellent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital!' reads as an old British exclamation meaning excellent, but it is the definition: the city.
explanation.definitionFit: Bucharest is the capital city of Romania.

clue.text: It need not give rise to punishment

indicators.note: to give rise to is to produce, so these letters are made into something new

explanation.surface: A suggestion that a misdeed need not lead to a penalty.
explanation.walkthrough: Detention is a school punishment of being kept in after hours.
explanation.definitionFit: Detention is a punishment in which a pupil is kept in school after hours.

clue.text: A time when the populace is at cross-purposes?

definitions.text: A time when the populace is at cross-purposes?

parts.words: A time when the populace is at cross-purposes?
parts.note: voters mark their ballot papers with a cross, so at polling time everyone has a cross purpose

explanation.definitionFit: At a vote, citizens mark a cross beside their choice on the ballot paper.

clue.text: A sign of wrong and right, we hear, in puzzle

indicators.note: we hear signals that the words are heard aloud, not spelt

parts.words: A sign of wrong and right
parts.note: a cross marks a wrong answer and a tick a right one, giving a cross tick

explanation.surface: A teacher's marks for errors and correct answers appear in a word game.
explanation.walkthrough: A CROSS TICK, said quickly, matches the answer's sound. In Britain a tick is the mark for a correct answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An acrostic is a word puzzle in which initial letters of lines spell a word.

clue.text: Running an exam in theory

parts.note: a machine that is running is on
an exam paper is the set of questions in a test

explanation.surface: Someone is overseeing a test.
explanation.definitionFit: Something true on paper holds in principle but perhaps not in practice.

clue.text: Clubs to beat?

parts.note: clubs looks like the card suit or sports teams, but these are wooden clubs used for beating

explanation.definitionFit: Cudgels are short thick sticks used as weapons for striking.

clue.text: Pulling to one side

parts.note: a wing is one side of a building, stage or team

explanation.surface: Someone is pulling over to the side.
explanation.definitionFit: Towing is pulling a vehicle or vessel behind with a rope or bar.

clue.text: The navy get under way in short film

indicators.note: in a down answer, getting under places this piece below the rest
in places one piece inside another

parts.note: wee is Scots for small or short
ST is street, a way
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: Sailors set off on a brief film.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get under way' looks like a ship setting off, but it splits: 'get under' places the navy below in this down answer, and 'way' is the street.
explanation.definitionFit: A western is a film genre set in the American Old West.

clue.text: Came about Daphne possibly receiving exercise

indicators.note: possibly suggests the name could be arranged another way

parts.note: PE is physical education, exercise

explanation.surface: Something occurred to Daphne while she was doing a workout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Daphne' reads as a person in the surface, but it is only letters to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Happened is a synonym for came about, meaning occurred.

clue.text: Open a damaged sunroof

indicators.note: damaged suggests the letters are knocked out of order

parts.note: a roof is the top of a building

explanation.surface: Someone opens a car's broken sunroof.
explanation.walkthrough: The single word 'sunroof' is split in two, and only its first half is rearranged by 'damaged'.
explanation.definitionFit: To unstop is to open by removing a stopper or blockage.

clue.text: Declare total

definitions.meaning: as an adjective, complete or absolute

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to voice words; as an adjective it means complete or absolute.

clue.text: Has to make professions of loyalty

indicators.note: to make is to form, so the letters are formed into something new

explanation.surface: Someone is obliged to swear allegiance.
explanation.definitionFit: Oaths are solemn pledges, such as of allegiance or loyalty.

clue.text: Quietly get in foreign capital for Greek city

indicators.note: to get in is to enter, so one piece goes inside another

parts.note: Delhi, the Indian capital region
p is piano, the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: Sneak into a distant capital on the way to a Greek destination.
explanation.definitionFit: Delphi was the ancient Greek city of the famous oracle of Apollo.

clue.text: Plea for Northeast to back contract

indicators.note: backing is going backwards, so the letters of Northeast's abbreviation read the other way

parts.note: a treaty is a formal contract between states

explanation.surface: A northern region makes an appeal to support a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: An entreaty is an earnest request, a synonym for a plea.

clue.text: Good man has a right to take the lead

parts.note: ST is saint, a good man

explanation.surface: A virtuous person rightly steps up to head things.
explanation.definitionFit: To star in a show is to play the lead role.

clue.text: Lack of restriction enjoyed by Pinocchio

definitions.meaning: the phrase means freedom from conditions or ties
the puppet in the Disney film sings that he has no cords holding him up

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means free of conditions; the wooden puppet who came alive has no cords attached, as his song says.
